# Krometrail

> Rust foundations for local browser control and temporal visual evidence for coding agents.

## Current state

The current executable exposes `--version`, `--help`, and `doctor`. The first two succeed; `doctor` reports that browser transport is not yet available. Browser capture, storage, temporal analysis, MCP tools, and debugger commands are not currently exposed.

## Contributor docs

- [Development](/guide/development): Rust build, test, lint, run, release, and docs tooling.
- [MCP configuration](/guide/mcp-configuration): current MCP status and intended Electron renderer boundary.
- [Runtime reference](/reference/runtime): current executable contract.
- [Configuration](/reference/configuration): current configuration status.
- [Documentation navigation](/agents): source-of-truth order.
